comparison.objective: Load an LP, place a stylus, and start playback versus commission a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Delicate disc extraction/seating, stylus lowering, and button pressing versus recessed key alignment, fine collar tuning, torque control, and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: LP seated, stylus on outer band, START pressed, and five seconds stable playback without handling violations versus two safe stops and no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Shared physical button actuation is generic and does not make these tested abilities overlap.
